name: GrainSmith Benchmark and Validation Dataset v1.1.0
description: This dataset contains the benchmark, validation, and molecular-dynamics stability data associated with GrainSmith v1.1.0, a generator of polycrystalline models for atomistic simulations with statistical and grain-boundary morphology control. The archive includes parallel-efficiency benchmarks as a function of CPU parallelism and grain count; validation campaigns for self-affine grain-boundary morphology, SDOT grain-size targeting, misorientation distributions, and texture fidelity; and molecular-dynamics stability calculations for representative flat, curved, and self-affine Cu polycrystals. The MD dataset contains the LAMMPS input decks, generated structures, simulation logs, and analysis scripts used for minimization, 300 K NPT stability tests, requenching, and grain-boundary-energy evaluation. Hardware, software versions, execution environments, and reproduction instructions are documented in the accompanying README.
